messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off rollout rl-2026-04-15-03 canary=10% -> scheduled step to 45% in 12m
rachel: synth smoke just flagged a small cluster of 429s from rate-limiter in eu-west for /generate - baseline 0, saw ~0.6% over last 2m :eyes:
dennis: interesting, latency is fine but 429 bursty. checking rate-limiter metrics and batching logs
maya: release notes mention a new request-batching optimizer (batch_opt_v2) on gateway that reduces CUDA kernel startups - could interact with limiter burstiness
triage-bot: INC-2026-210 created - postdeploy 429 burst from rate-limiter
dennis: observed short-lived queue buildup around gateway-worker-7 during canary window, backlog spikes correlated with batch flushes from batch_opt_v2
rachel: are these causing client retries? we saw % retries bump on synth runner but final success rate still >99%
dennis: yes some synths retried, which flattened load then caused a retry storm for a tiny window -> limiter tripped for a subset of keys
ops-bot: smoke-probe (pre-mitigation) -> 429s=0.6% p95=180ms p99=420ms status=degraded
maya: suggestion: pause ramp and pin /generate to previous routing/model variant that doesn't enable batch_opt_v2 while we instrument and add backpressure smoothing
rachel: +1 pause and pin, prefer conservative approach for customer-facing generate route
dennis: sample pin call to run (ops):
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/generate","variant":"stable-2026-04-14"}
```
ops-bot: executing pin -> applying /generate -> stable-2026-04-14 (actor: ops-bot) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied to /generate -> stable-2026-04-14
ops-bot: smoke-probe (post-pin) -> 429s=0.02% p95=165ms p99=210ms status=ok
rachel: looks back to expected levels after pin, good catch
dennis: will add a short smoothing window to batch_opt_v2 and a circuit-breaker to limiter keys in next patch; opening RFC-2026-221
maya: retrospective item: add a mini-concurrency synthetic that toggles batching on/off to catch limiter interactions in preflight
triage-bot: INC-2026-210 marked monitoring; awaiting stable 30m window before close
ops-bot: note added to changelog: "paused rollout and pinned /generate to stable-2026-04-14 due to transient 429 bursts correlated with new batching optimization; follow-up RFC-2026-221"
rachel: leaving canary at 10% for 30m. will update thread if noise returns
